about: What gemini-pro-latest said, blind, of the old and the new of each sound (tools/sound/listen.mjs), 17 November 2026: what it heard, the nearest label, how convincing 1-10 as what it is meant to be, and what gives it away. `old` is the game own sound, `now` the one made again; null: not asked, or no answer. What was done with these verdicts is docs/WILD.md, Sounds made again.

stepConcrete.meant: one footstep of a soldier in boots on a concrete floor

old.heard: A short, high-pitched synthetic beep resembling a classic video game sound effect.
old.label: synthetic beep or video game bleep

now.heard: I heard a short, high-pitched synthetic beep, like a video game menu selection.
now.label: synthetic beep or video game bleep
faults: Unnatural tonal resonance in low end

stepMetal.meant: one footstep of a soldier in boots on a steel grating

old.heard: I can hear a single footstep on a hard surface.
old.label: footstep
faults: High frequencies sound like generic white noise

now.heard: It is a short synthetic beep like a video game menu sound.
now.label: synthetic beep or video game bleep
faults: Resonance is too tonal and bell-like
Lacks the complex rattle of a grating
Initial impact is too sharp for a boot

stepDirt.meant: one footstep of a soldier in boots on dirt and gravel

old.heard: A single footstep on a hard surface.
old.label: footstep
faults: Crunch sounds like filtered white noise
Low end thump is slightly weak

now.heard: A single footstep on a hard surface.
now.label: footstep
faults: Gravel scatter sounds like uniform white noise

Mechanical servo sound is too tonal

now.heard: A short, sharp click, like a button being pressed in a software interface.
now.label: user interface click

sentryAlert.meant: a guard robot's loud alert bark from its loudspeaker: it has seen an intruder

sentryLost.meant: a guard robot's low, giving-up electronic sound: it has lost its target

now.heard: A short burst of unrecognisable noise.

sentryDown.meant: a walking machine shutting down: its motors winding down and its body settling

old.heard: This is a short, low-pitched synthetic bleep reminiscent of a retro video game sound effect.
old.label: synthetic beep or video game bleep
faults: Sounds like a simple synthetic oscillator
Missing mechanical clanks and settling impacts
Pitch envelope is too smooth and artificial

now.heard: I heard a short burst of unrecognisable noise.
now.label: noise burst (nothing recognisable)
faults: Sounds like a retro arcade synth beep
Lacks mechanical friction and gear noise
No heavy physical impact for settling

droneDown.meant: a drone shot down: rotors spinning down and the airframe hitting the floor

old.heard: A sharp, synthetic click resembling a user interface button press.
old.label: user interface click
faults: Rotor spin-down sounds like a smooth sci-fi laser sweep instead of buzzing propellers.
Impact lacks low-end weight sounding like a small plastic toy.
No mechanical crunch or debris scatter upon impact.

now.heard: A quick, high-pitched synthetic bleep resembling a retro video game sound effect.
now.label: synthetic beep or video game bleep

Impact sound is too weak and lacks physical crunch

Lack of acoustic space or room reverberation

now.label: synthetic beep or video game bleep

Completely dry with no acoustic space
